programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.desc: Reality series following life at Count's Kustoms, a car customisation and restoration company in Las Vegas. After commissioning a special gift for a new band member, UK metallers Judas Priest turn up to collect the goods. Danny eyes up a 1969 Caddy.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Drew heads to an antiques shop in Edinburgh on a hunt for new stock and on an expedition to a 750-year-old house, he discovers an item that takes him out of his comfort zone.

programs.title: Ice Road Truckers
programs.desc: In the midst of the early thaw, Darrell and Lisa struggle to make it home over the hardest hit trail on the winter roads system. Art and the King of Obsolete reunite to haul a giant double trailer over a slick path. Veteran Alex Debogorski races against the clock to deliver to a town in need before the road closes, while fellow Polar driver Todd Burke finds a unique way to conquer a melted ice crossing.

programs.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programs.desc: After buying most of a mysterious island in Nova Scotia, Canada, two Michigan brothers go on the search, one that has led to several deaths, for a legendary treasure and discover clues proving the validity of its existence somewhere on the island.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Mike finds a rare Land Rover Series 1 for sale, but alarm bells start ringing when he discovers that the car was apparently manufactured in 1963, five years after Series 1 production ended. The project soon turns into a complicated ground-up restoration.

programs.title: How Do They Do It?
programs.sub_title: Barra Airport, Sun-dried Tomatoes and Lederhosen
programs.desc: How do planes take off and land on a beach at one of the world's oldest airports? And, how do they hand-make the national dress of Bavaria, lederhosen?
